reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Soothing Cream+ 100mL_NEW
reviews.text: i got this for my sister and she really likes it, she’s got oily/combo skin and it’s perfect for her! it’s not heavily scented but it does smell like tea tree in case that is important to someone hehe
reviews.zh: 買咗畀我阿妹，佢好鍾意。佢係油性/混合性肌，呢款啱晒佢！香味唔算濃，但有茶樹味，希望呢點幫到有需要嘅人 hehe

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Soothing Cream+ 100mL_NEW
reviews.text: It feels cool when applied to the skin. It has a strong menthol smell but that goes away after applying. It absorbs quickly, but my skin still felt dry afterwards, so the moisturizing power is slightly lacking.
reviews.zh: 搽上皮膚有涼浸浸嘅感覺。薄荷味好重，但搽完之後就會散。吸收得快，不過之後皮膚仲係覺得有啲乾，保濕力略嫌唔夠。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Soothing Cream+ 100mL_NEW
reviews.text: Love love love! I’ve been ordering this for the past two years, using it continuously throughout all seasons. I will say , for winter do around two layers for extra moisture.
reviews.zh: 超鍾意超鍾意超鍾意！呢兩年嚟一直持續訂購，一年四季都用緊。我會建議冬天用兩層左右加強保濕。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Soothing Cream+ 100mL_NEW
reviews.text: Amazing! This is my first time trying a non American based moisturizer. I loved how quickly it absorbed as it’s not too thick and the soothing elements began working by the next morning! It smells really good, but not so strong it is irritating. Seems a bit oily at first when you pat it in, but absorbs all the same. Will absolutely be getting more once this bottle runs out.
reviews.zh: 超正！第一次用非美國品牌嘅保濕產品。好鍾意佢唔算厚但吸收得快，第二朝舒緩成分已經開始見效！味道好好聞，但唔會濃到令人刺激。輕拍上面時起初有少少油笠笠，但一樣會吸收。呢支用完一定會再回購。

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Soothing Cream+ 100mL_NEW
reviews.text: Love this shooting cream! It's perfect for combination skin to feel moisturised and fresh at the same time. It's really fresh and light, it will be absorbed very quickly, I love it!
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢款舒緩霜！混合性肌用落保濕又清新，perfect！質地清爽輕盈，吸收極快，勁鍾意！

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Soothing Cream+ 100mL_NEW
reviews.text: Literally my go to! It sucks not many know about this product specifically as it’s perfect for those who tend to get congestion with typical a moisturizers. Especially now that it’s summer time! It’s very thin and it has a slight smell but it’s bearable. It doesn’t irritate any problematic areas, if anything, it helps reducing irritation. I always stock up in pairs or bulks!
reviews.zh: 簡直係我嘅必備！可惜冇咩人識呢款產品，佢真係啱晒容易因為一般保濕品而堵塞毛孔嘅人。尤其而家係夏天！質地好薄，有少少味但仲接受得到。對有問題嘅皮膚部位唔會造成刺激，甚至有助減少刺激感。我通常都會成對或者大量入手！

reviews.shade: BRINGGREEN Tea Tree Cica Soothing Cream+ 100mL_NEW
reviews.text: I love it. I try to avoid product that prevent acne because they use to have strong ingredients, but the bringgreen tea tree viva soothing cream has bees amazing, I realize it has very natural ingredients and works amazing with my sensitive skin, truly recomendaciones it, feels soft and refreshing.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意。本來會避免用防暗瘡產品，因為通常成分都比較刺激，但 bringgreen 茶樹 viva 舒緩霜真係超正，發覺成分好天然，同我敏感肌夾到，真心推薦，用落柔軟清爽。
